opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by the time of taking up the Fellowship; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years, with the Trust contributing 100% of salary in year one and 50% in years two and three.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post at a UK university or eligible research organisation; must live in the UK for at least 26 weeks a year.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare results for publication, tenable for 3 to 24 months.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities holding research degree awarding powers in their own right; consortia of up to two universities allowed.
opportunities.summary: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships: up to 30 doctoral scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area, including additional places for underrepresented groups, postdoctoral opportunities and administrative support, over 9 years.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers; single university or collaboration between multiple institutions.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary Research Centre round opens in February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research, with replacement salary costs for 2 to 3 years.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship duration; resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, tenable for 3 to 24 months, providing replacement costs and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career scholars with at least two years' research/teaching experience after PhD, holding a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent at a UK university, or nominated by a UK university.
opportunities.summary: For talented early career scholars to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, over 4 to 5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or other institutions of higher education; UK-based independent research institutes/organisations on a trial basis.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project, up to 5 years. The outline stage is paused; detailed applications close 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas; applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge in an underrepresented area of research, for visits of 3 to 12 months.
